scientific_integrity: Analytic proof from exact linear power transformation and cumulative-rate comparison, with finite algebraic and numerical corroboration only; independent replication or audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic continuous homogeneous power-law population dynamics; added bounded per-capita loss and integrated-rate budgets. Comparisons are restricted to the positive model domain N at least N_ref, and threshold access is assessed before reaching N_ref. This is not a theorem for stochastic, discrete, congested or heterogeneous models; monetary costs and removal counts are not represented by integrated per-capita rate.
title: Sharp bounded-effort containment frontier for a collaboration-driven population threshold
